subject: Onsite demo: Meridian AI — scheduling & NDA
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie@meridianai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Onsite demo at Redwood HQ — week of Jul 18

Hi Karthik,

Hope you’re doing well. We’re excited to move forward with an in-person demo at Redwood HQ for our product and a small integration discussion. We’re planning travel for the week of July 18 and wanted to check availability for a half-day demo + Q&A and a short workshop (approx. 3 hours).

A few quick asks up front:
- Do you have a mutual NDA we can sign before the visit?
- What conference rooms could accommodate 8–10 people with AV (projector + HDMI) and a whiteboard?
- Any visitor parking or security check-in requirements?

Attendees will include me (Sophie Turner), our engineering lead Marcus Holt, and two product managers. We may also bring one of our procurement contacts for contract-level questions.

Thanks — can you confirm point people at Redwood and any initial availability so we can lock travel?

Best,
Sophie Turner
Head of Partnerships
Meridian AI
Sophie Turner

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@meridianai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Onsite demo at Redwood HQ — week of Jul 18

Hi Sophie — great to hear from you, and thanks for the heads-up.

We’d love to host Meridian at our Novato HQ. Quick answers:
- NDA: Yes — I’ll pull our standard mutual NDA and send it for signature. If you have one you prefer, send it over and we’ll route to legal.
- Rooms: We have a configurable room (Kestrel) that fits 12 with AV and a mic; we also have a larger boardroom (Falcon) if you want a separate breakout. I’ll loop Lauren (events) to confirm AV and catering options.
- Parking/security: We provide guest parking permits and front desk check-in; will need a visitor list ahead of time.

Proposed slots: Mon Jul 20 or Tue Jul 21, 10:00–13:00 PDT. Does either work for your team?

Monica (CS) will be the technical owner on the day. Lauren, can you confirm room/AV/catering availability and whether we can print temporary visitor badges?

Thanks — I’ll draft the NDA and send a DocuSign link shortly.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Turner <sophie@meridianai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Meridian AI Logistics <logistics@meridianai.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Onsite demo at Redwood HQ — week of Jul 18

Thanks Karthik — Tue Jul 21 is preferable for our travel team (Mon is tight).

A couple more items:
- AV: We’ll need HDMI + Mac adapter, and one lapel mic for the presenter.
- Visitor list: I’ll attach a rough attendee list once travel is confirmed. We may bring a contractor who needs a short access waiver.
- Food: Simple boxed lunches are fine. Any dietary notes you need?
- Can you confirm whether the legal team requires any special clauses for data/retention? We’re prepared to sign a mutual NDA but want to check for show-stopping terms.

Also — if there’s a cost for dedicated AV technician or room setup, please flag so we can route budget.

Sophie

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Meridian onsite — Jul 21 logistics / NDA

Team — quick coordination note before I confirm with Sophie: we’re setting Meridian for Tue Jul 21, 10:00–13:00 in Kestrel. Action items: 
- Lauren: please book Kestrel for 09:30–14:00 (buffer for setup/cleanup), confirm HDMI + Mac adapter + 1 lapel mic, and arrange 8 boxed lunches (2 vegetarian). Also confirm visitor badge printing and parking permits (2 cars).
- Monica: you’ll lead the demo flow. Can you prep a 45-min deep-dive with a short live test? Also, collect any IP/data boundary talking points for legal.
- Markus: adding you on this in case any contractual sign-off is needed; we may need a brief exec intro.

I’m drafting the mutual NDA now and will send to Sophie via DocuSign. Tentative filenames: Meridian_Redwood_Mutual_NDA_20260702.pdf and visitor_badge_list_20260721.xlsx.

If there are any conflicts, call out now — otherwise I’ll confirm with Sophie at 11:00.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@meridianai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Meridian AI Logistics <logistics@meridianai.com>

- Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026
- Time: 10:00–13:00 PDT (we’ll open the room at 09:30)
- Room: Kestrel (configurable — AV projector + HDMI + Mac adapter, 1 lapel mic)

Logistics & parking:
- Please send the full visitor list (names + ID types) by Fri Jul 16; front desk will need that to pre-print badges.

- Basic AV and a technician for the session are complimentary. If you request specialized recording equipment or additional mics, we’ll review costs and confirm.

Confirm: I’ll send the calendar invite after DocuSign completes; please confirm final attendee names by Fri Jul 16 so Lauren can pre-print badges.

Attachments referenced:
- Meridian_Redwood_Mutual_NDA_20260702.pdf (attachment stub)
- visitor_badge_list_20260721.xlsx (attachment stub)
